nodes.label: Kindergarten Simple Pitch Generator
nodes.rationale: Organizes customer language per avatar into problem / emotional pain / root cause / root solution (Big Idea) / how the product solves it / benefits / side effects, all first-person at a 6.5 reading level so the reader feels 'THAT'S ME!!'. Rules: synthesize don't list, extract all numbers, label the 80/20, show before/after contrasts.
